title: Meris McElveen
text:
Hi! My name is Meris and I’m a senior studying biology and information science at UNC Chapel Hill. I am currently an Undergraduate researcher in the Rob Dowen Lab, studying the crosstalk between gut metabolism in C. elegans!
I am passionate about research and the cross-section between health and data analytics! Please feel free to reach about anything!
